descriptions.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]看上去荒无人烟，但我们的扫描仪却接收了一段被加密的信号，正是从这上面发射出来的。
descriptions.en: Although [Root.GetName] appears totally desolate and devoid of life, our scanners have picked up an encrypted signal emanating from it.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]表面的大洋之下，有一个不同寻常的巨大物体正在发出星星点点的光芒。
descriptions.en: Starlight can be seen glinting off an unusually large object, just under the ocean surface of [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 这颗行星有着令人难以置信的异乎寻常的美景。这到底是什么样的力量塑造而成的？
descriptions.en: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?
